description: La₂NaTaO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-43°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.43 Å. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-3.14 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-43°. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent La, and one Ta atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Ta atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLa₂Ta tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent La, and one Ta atom.
